title: Polish Spike tip dock dismiss and avatar
summary: Spike tip dock dismiss control is a clear top-right close control, the dock avatar uses the pointing Spike artwork, and previous page dismissals are reset so the redesigned tip can appear again.
changes: Replaced the Hide tip text control with a high-contrast top-right × close button on the tip bubble.
Swapped the dock avatar to full-body pointing Spike artwork oriented toward the tip bubble.
Rotated the local dismiss storage key so earlier page hide choices do not conceal the redesigned tip dock.
version_rationale: A backward-compatible patch polishing tip-dock presentation and dismiss behaviour without changing tip copy, routes, or permissions.
validation: MascotHelperTest feature coverage for the dock avatar and dismiss control, plus myapes:changelog-validate against origin/main.
known_limitations: Previously dismissed tips reappear once under the new dismiss storage key; hiding a tip again still remembers that page locally.
rollback: Revert this release record, VERSION, runtime manifest version, tip-dock Blade/CSS/JS updates, spike-dock artwork, README asset note, and related feature assertions. No database rollback is needed.
provenance: Defined by the Spike tip dock dismiss and avatar polish for MyAPES Account issue #74 and pull request #75.
